title: Mate projection data on the small coordinate-ring colimit model
statement: For f:X→S, a geometric point s, K in D⁺(Ab(X_et)), integer n and canonical geometry Q [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry], use the section homology map of the derived base-change mate and define its exact-sections Leray target isomorphism on T=strictHenselizationScheme(s) using [def-weil-pbc-exact-global-sections-leray]. SmallModelStrictLocalMateProjectionData gives stage identifications from derived sections of Rf_*K [def-weil-pbc-canonical-derived-cohomology-germs] to neighbourhood hypercohomology, compatible with transition pullbacks, and identifies each canonical small-model source leg [def-weil-pbc-small-model-cohomology-germs] followed by the mate with projection pullback along the transported legs Q.smallModelLegs of [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-small-model-geometry-transport] followed by the inverse target isomorphism. It does not include a source or target colimit assertion.

proof.text: Construct smallModel_strictLocalBaseChangeTargetIso by applying exactGlobalSectionsLerayHomologyIso to the small-model base-change projection, with the proved exactness of global sections on strictHenselizationScheme. This is the same explicit composite as before, with no choice or new proof obligation.

Package the stage isomorphisms, their transition equations, and the equality between each small-model source leg followed by the sections homology map of the derived mate and projection restriction followed by the inverse target comparison. Use the canonical neighbourhood geometry transported to the small model. Every field has the previous type verbatim up to the explicit small-model target-isomorphism name. This defines data, not its existence, and has no colimit or invertibility-of-mate assertion. No positivity or nonzero-complex assumption is introduced.
